entries.why: Labour removed: the text says the IMF required spending cuts; the 80% wage-adjustment decree is not stated as an IMF requirement. Before: ['cuts', 'labour']; after: ['cuts'].

Deval removed: the only support is IMF staff saying the move was 'in line with staff advice' - advice, not a stated requirement. Prices and tax stay (the programme 'called for' them). Before: ['prices', 'tax', 'deval']; after: ['prices', 'tax'].
Invest removed: the credit 'helped draft regulations' for the mining law - a funded activity, not a requirement attached to the money. Before: ['priv', 'cuts', 'invest']; after: ['priv', 'cuts'].

Prices removed: IMF directors 'advised' fuel prices follow world prices and IRIN says rises were 'in line with IMF policy' - advice, not a requirement. Wage-bill and exchange-rate commitments in the letter of intent stay. Before: ['prices', 'cuts', 'deval']; after: ['cuts', 'deval'].
Repay removed: 'sovereign-guaranteed loan' is the IDB lending window's label, not a repayment term the text says was attached. Safeguard stays. Before: ['repay', 'safeguard']; after: ['safeguard'].
Repay removed: 'sovereign-guaranteed loan' is only the IDB product label for a loan to the state; no condition is described, so need_research. Before: ['repay']; after: ['need_research'].
Repay removed: 'sovereign-guaranteed loan' is only the ADB product label; no condition is described, so need_research. Before: ['repay']; after: ['need_research'].
Law added (missed): the second tranche also depended on setting up a power regulator. Before: ['priv']; after: ['priv', 'law'].

Tax quote replaced: the budget-approval quote did not show a tax; the memorandum's Tajir Doost revenue measure does. The budget prior action is a budget target, so cuts added with that quote. Before: ['prices', 'tax']; after: ['prices', 'tax', 'cuts'].

none -> land (missed): the deal with the company required the town to move, i.e. land made available for the project (same reading the tagger used for afobaka-dam-alcoa-saamaka). Before: ['none']; after: ['land']. [also in none spot-check sample]

none -> land (missed): the companies' money bought land on the term that it be closed to use for their carbon credits. The old 'none' quote ('US companies, not grant-makers') did not say there was no condition. Before: ['none']; after: ['land']. [also in none spot-check sample]

need_research -> repay (missed): state guarantees on the loan to the company, read the same way as the tagger's other guaranteed-loan cases. Before: ['need_research']; after: ['repay']. [also in need_research spot-check sample]

need_research -> repay (missed): South Africa stood surety for the loan, same reading as other guaranteed-loan cases. Before: ['need_research']; after: ['repay']. [also in need_research spot-check sample]

Empty, not flagged -> safeguard: USAID attached a use restriction (no funds for sterilization campaigns), the funder's own project rule. The case had ct [] with need_research false, which the rules do not allow. Before: []; after: ['safeguard'].

Empty, not flagged -> safeguard: EIB disbursement conditions on the project (permit, design). The resettlement plan was only a 'possible condition' and is not counted. Before: []; after: ['safeguard'].
